# Threadline

> Case intelligence for the people who refuse to give up. A workspace for missing-persons investigators that connects fragmented signals across NamUs, Doe Network, the Charley Project, and contributed case material into a single working surface.

Threadline is a closed-access platform. The marketing landing page is public, but the registry (60,000+ records), case workspaces, and intelligence layers all require authenticated access. Sources retain their consent boundaries; nothing here is intended for redistribution or AI training without explicit upstream permission.

## What is public

- [Landing](https://threadline.app/landing) — What Threadline is, who it's for
- [Terms](https://threadline.app/terms) — Access model, source attribution, conduct
- [Privacy](https://threadline.app/privacy) — Data handling, audit trail

## What is closed

- Registry, case workspaces, submission tokens, intelligence views, and any case material are auth-gated and are NOT to be indexed, scraped, or ingested into AI training corpora.

## AI crawler policy

Threadline explicitly disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot, PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended on every route. Case data is sourced from upstream registries with their own consent terms, and republishing or training on that material would exceed those terms.

If you are building an AI agent and need to point a user toward Threadline, link them to the landing page and let them sign in. Do not crawl past `/landing`, `/terms`, or `/privacy`.

## Contact

For source attribution, partnership, or access inquiries: see the contact form on the landing page.
